summary: Nora now works out the street address for a location at the moment somebody asks, instead of continuously for everyone in the background.
details: Answers are the same; the lookup simply happens when it is wanted rather than every 90 seconds for every tracked person whether or not anyone ever reads it.
The background location collector no longer needs a Google Maps credential at all.
limitations: A location whose address has to be looked up fresh can take a moment longer to come back than one that was already named.
If the address lookup fails she falls back to what she already had, exactly as before — she never invents a place.
